senses.gloss:
Dhaumya
------------------------------------------
One of the important sages mentioned in the Mahābhārata is धौम्य. He was the son of Vyāghrapāda and the teacher of another well-known sage (a great devotee of शिव) उपमन्यु.
Being the royal priest of the Pāṇḍavas he had to play many roles in their life. When the Pāṇḍavas were banished to the forest he is said to have accompanied them. It is he who taught युधिष्ठिर (the eldest of the Pāṇḍavas) the rite of pleasing the Sun-god and obtain the divine vessel of ड़ोओद् (known as अक्षयपात्र) from him. He was the chief priest at the मर्रिअगे of द्रौपदी to the five Pāṇḍavas and also at the राजसूय sacrifice performed by them at इन्द्र-prastha. When the Pāṇḍavas lived incognito in the kingdom of विराट, he protected their Vedic fires.
It was again he who performed the चोरोनतिओन् ceremony of युधिष्ठिर after his victory in the कुरुक्षेत्र war.
